dataset.encoding: strict ASCII128, one byte per token

limitations: A single sequential-order development control, not new quality confirmation.
Inherited host count fitting is part of model history, not new fitting or FPGA learning.
Optimizer comparison changes magnitude/deadband/update scaling together; it does not isolate remainder alone.
Native SignSGD is the frozen algorithm, but this is CPU CSIM, not physical image equivalence.
Training update comparisons occurred in the worker; posthoc checks rehash receipts/arrays and recompute checkpoints.
Training route digests are retained, not complete raw training route arrays.

recipe.baseline_policy: alpha1 full inherited fit plus actual sequential replay prefix; retain one-pass comparator too
recipe.comparison: completed count_fitted_k18 EF cell; same original weights, sequential windows, z2 and development40..55
recipe.evaluation: native lr0 mode3 still executes backward; complete weights unchanged; fixed context-disabled host probe
recipe.initialization: exact full weight payload from completed prior count_fitted_k18 state0; zero native gradients
recipe.optimizer: frozen integer SignSGD: w-=sign(G)*lr iff abs(G)>threshold; clear gradients
recipe.scope: one causal development control, not three-seed confirmation, final test, speed, physical FPGA or paid gate
recipe.training_guard: host observer every window: no forward saturation/int32 overflow; preflight all int16 updates; compare actual native predictions/logit gradients/routes and all post-update weights
recipe.verification: every training step checked by worker; posthoc verifier rehashes training arrays/weight-chain receipts and recomputes checkpoints, not a second complete training replay
